verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows generic mentions of 'managing transfers' and transfer-lock toggling (godaddy-docs-6/21/34), but nothing documents the actual EPP/auth-code transfer-in flow, transfer status tracking, transfer pricing, or how remaining registration time is handled. Community evidence (godaddy-comm-11) even suggests GoDaddy obstructs whois-based transfer processes rather than documenting them cleanly. Missing for 10: EPP/auth-code request and submission flow, transfer status/tracking API or UI, transfer-in cost documentation, and rules on remaining registration time credit.
